execution_scope: After explicit approval, request one normal Arc quit; never force quit or discard an unsaved-work prompt. If Arc remains running after30seconds, leave its four directories untouched.
Recheck all exact paths: no symlink target/ancestor or descendant; no path substitution; no retained evidence or final build output.
Remeasure seven targets; stop if total allocation exceeds2GiB or path identity/type changed. No expansion to parent directories.
Recheck active builders and open handles. Skip any target in active use or with incomplete evidence.
Delete only the seven listed cache directories, preserving all parent/profile directories. No process kill, permission repair, forced unmount or retry on failure.
Record each outcome and fresh free bytes after completion; stop on first deletion error. Partial completion must be explicit.
No native probe, build or downstream run is included.
preserved: All source/worktrees and .artifacts evidence, native builds/symbols/diagnostics
Sellr DerivedData products, logs, symbols, archives and source
Simulator devices/runtimes, installed apps and sessions
Codex browser cache while current task runs; all Codex task history/runtime/plugins
Arc cookies/local storage/service workers/profile roots and user files/downloads
Installed SDKs, Docker data and pending app updates
Previously failed dotslash path; no permission changes
limits_of_scan: Bounded directory allocation inventory, not whole-disk ownership or stale-file proof. Protected macOS cache directories and one protected pyc were unreadable; not proposed. lsof exit code alone is insufficient: Arc cache checks returned rows despite code1. Counts/open use must be checked from output.
approval_gate: AGENTS.md Approval gates: The user must explicitly approve ... destructive cleanup. The earlier completed cache cleanup is not a standing deletion allowance.
next_after_cleanup: Evaluate fresh capacity. P3 preflight operation is already consumed; a new exact bounded native operation requires approval.
